data.name: Club Med La Caravelle
data.description:
On a lush property flanked by Anse Accul and Anse de Sainte-Anne in the Caribbean Sea, this laid-back, all-inclusive beachfront resort is 20 km from Centre Saint-John Perse port.
Relaxed rooms have complimentary Wi-Fi and flat-screens. Suites add living areas, as well as balconies with sea views. In-room breakfast is available.
Meals and drinks are included. There’s a casual eatery with a terrace and water views, plus an airy restaurant on the beach, 2 bars, and an outdoor pool. Other amenities include archery, tennis and windsurfing, as well as sailing, kayaking and paddleboarding. Fitness classes, a kids’ club and live shows are also offered.
